kgs and OEDIV announce partnership

09/23/2021

OEDIV Oetker Daten- und Informationsverarbeitung KG and KGS Software GmbH are to work together even more closely in the field of SAP archiving. The aim of the partnership is to provide OEDIV’s customers and prospects with quicker and easier support with professional archiving concepts and solutions. 
As certified SAP partners, the target clientele of both kgs and OEDIV predominantly comprises companies with an IT infrastructure in which SAP is the leading system. Consequently, the cooperation between an established SAP hosting partner and a prestigious SAP archiving expert offers customers and users a major advantage: They benefit from great expertise and joint services in the SAP archiving arena. 
“kgs’ high-performance archive has been specifically developed for the needs of SAP archiving. Backed by OEDIV’s established data centre solutions, a wide range of different archiving requirements can be addressed and implemented,” says Delia Wulle, Managing Director of OEDIV. Martin Stratmann, likewise Managing Director of OEDIV, adds: “kgs’ solutions are particularly lean, yet deliver high performance. If our customers decide in favour of our joint services, they obtain a smart, secure and reliable archiving solution.” 
Winfried Althaus, Managing Director of KGS Software GmbH, emphasises: “Thanks to our close cooperation with OEDIV, we can now pitch our solutions and services to an even broader market and effectively reduce the workload our prospects, customers and users face when archiving documents and data. That’s a big advantage – especially in the case of migration to an OEDIV data centre or transition to SAP S/4HANA.” Winfried Althaus adds: “In addition, the kgs licences can not only be purchased, but also booked as a subscription individually and to suit needs. Together with OEDIV, kgs thus offers highly scalable SaaS solutions and is well-positioned to tackle future challenges.” 

About kgs 
KGS Software GmbH, which is headquartered in Neu-Isenburg near Frankfurt am Main, has been the digital archiving specialist for top companies worldwide for more than 20 years. Data and documents from SAP, as well as documents from other leading applications, are migrated and archived by means of high-performance, lean software. Under the brand “tia®” – the intelligent archive –, the archive vendor has since 2020 combined all kgs product modules to create a common vision for smart document archiving. tia® stands for autonomous archiving, can be integrated with any desired applications, storage solutions and cloud technologies, and offers companies a single point of truth (SPoT) for accessing documents. Since 2005 kgs has certified ArchiveLink® and ILM interfaces for SAP worldwide and is a Global SAP Value Added Solutions Partner. More information can be found at: www.kgs-software.com
